verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮਂੈ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਭਏ ਬਾਰਨੀ ਬਿਗੰਧ ਗੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੰਗ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh saadh sa(n)g ra(n)g ma(n)ai ra(n)geele bhe baaranee biga(n)dh ga(n)g sa(n)g mile ga(n)g hai ||

en.bdb: As evil smelling wine when poured into river Ganges become like the water of Ganges, so can vice ridden, maya (mammon) immersed, worldly pleasure seeking individuals get dyed in the hue of Naam Simran when they join the true, Naam immersed holy company of devoted Sikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੰਗਮ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: surasaree sa(n)gam haivai prabal pravaeh liv saagar athaeh satigur sa(n)g sa(n)g hai ||

en.bdb: As the rapid flow of brooks and rivers like Ganges merges into the vast ocean losing all their destructive traits, so can one get absorbed into the ocean like Satguru by keeping the company of true, loving and devoted Sikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh nihachal chit dharasan sobhaa nidh lahar tara(n)g hai ||

en.bdb: The mind stabilises in the fragrant dust of Satguru’s feet. The glimpse of infinite praise, myriad colourful waves of Naam appear in his consciousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨੂ ਗਯਾਨ ਅੰਸ ਹੰਸ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਹੈ ॥੮੮॥
verses.translit_en: anahadh sabadh kai sarab nidhaan dhaanoo gayaan a(n)s ha(n)s gat sumat sraba(n)g hai ||88||

en.bdb: By virtue of Naam Simran and appearance of unstruck music in the consciousness, a Sikh feels he has been blessed with all the treasures of the world. He acquires knowledge of the True Guru that reflects in every hair of his body. (88)
